label: Soft Shadow Circle
author: Conky-Studio
description: Filled circle with a multi-pass soft drop shadow for depth. Use as a premium status disc, avatar plate, or floating marker.
lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, R = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}
 local ox, oy = {shadow_offset_x}, {shadow_offset_y}
 local spread = {shadow_spread}
 local sop = {shadow_opacity}
 -- soft shadow: several expanding translucent discs
 if spread > 0 and sop > 0 then
  for i = 4, 1, -1 do
   local t = i / 4
   local rr = R + spread * t
   local a = sop * (0.12 + 0.18 * (1 - t))
   cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 0, 0, 0, a)
   cairo_arc(cr, cx + ox, cy + oy, rr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
   cairo_fill(cr)
  end
 end
 -- body
 local r, g, b = {color}
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity})
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 -- optional rim
 if {ring} then
  local rr, gg, bb = {ring_color}
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, {ring_width})
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, rr, gg, bb, {opacity})
  cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R - {ring_width} * 0.5, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
